variants.name: literacy
variants.prompt: Square 1:1 photorealistic editorial photograph, natural soft lighting, shallow depth of field, modern Korean corporate setting. The main subject is a single young Korean man in his late 20s, shown from behind, from the side in profile turned away, or cropped so his face is not visible. Any other people are secondary, out of focus and not facing the camera. Subject centered so it still reads when cropped to a circle or a narrow vertical strip. No text, no logos, no watermarks. Seen from behind over his shoulder, he sits in a bright training room looking at a laptop showing a generative AI chat interface, pointing at the screen, blurred colleagues in the background.
